entities.summary: Mike McKenna is an American former professional ice hockey goaltender. McKenna was selected in the sixth round of the 2002 NHL entry draft by the Nashville Predators and played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Tampa Bay Lightning, New Jersey Devils, Columbus Blue Jackets, Arizona Coyotes, Dallas Stars, Ottawa Senators and Philadelphia Flyers. Mckenna worked the 2022 Stanley Cup Playoffs for TNT.
